tasks.short: Render design ideas as drawings and paste-ups.

steps.what: Render design ideas as drawings.
Render design ideas as paste-ups.
Accept the design drawings they render.
File the design drawings they render.

tasks.design: The designer renders the design ideas as drawings and as paste-ups. The file stores the drawings only after they accept them. Nothing generates an image.
tasks.previous_blocker: Rendering the idea is the work. Filing the drawing is a second pass.
tasks.enabler_now: A project file can hold a drawing the designer has already rendered and accepted.
tasks.still_hard: The idea is the designer's, and a generated picture would be a different object.
tasks.human_edge: The designer renders the ideas and accepts the drawings. The file stores that set.
tasks.altitude: Rendering drawings and paste-ups stays with the designer. The file holds the drawings only after they accept them. No image is generated.

reach.task: Look at drawings the designer rendered
reach.learn: The drawing was made by the designer

evidence.claim: A drawing the designer rendered can be stored after they accept it. No image is generated, so nothing has to be labelled as a generated picture.

The designer judges safety, accessibility, and what the design should be. A tool does not certify compliance and does not generate the design. National rules decide which accessibility and safety duties apply. EU data-protection rules cover a client's home and their preferences. Client conferences are not stored as audio. A drawing or a specification is filed only after the designer made it. This work does not generate or edit an image.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a design idea is ready to show and ends when the accepted drawings are on the file. Rendering stays with the designer. No image is generated or edited.
The fields are idea, the drawing the designer rendered, and their acceptance. The designer produces the drawing. If a sheet is missing, they render it. Nothing generates a picture.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree on the rendering. They disagree only about filing drawings the designer has already accepted.
Upkeep is keeping the drawing names aligned with the file.
unknowns: Whether the client still wants a physical paste-up.
Which sheet the office uses for a presentation drawing.
research_questions: Does the client still want a physical paste-up?
Which sheet does the office use for a presentation drawing?

already_counted.description: Rendering design ideas as drawings stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Keep the drawing names aligned with the file

approvals.approved_version: drawings the designer accepted after rendering them

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the client still wants a physical paste-up, that stays, and the low end is the rendering, which stays either way. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Subcontract fabrication of the furniture.
Subcontract installation of carpeting and fixtures.
Set the arrangement of accessories and draperies.
Choose related items for that arrangement.
Accept the subcontract for those items.
Send the accepted subcontract.

tasks.design: The designer subcontracts fabrication and installation, sets the arrangement of accessories and draperies, and chooses the related items, including paint and coverings. Only the subcontract they accept is sent. Nothing chooses a firm or an item.
tasks.previous_blocker: Choosing the work and the firm is the judgement. Sending the same subcontract is a second pass.
tasks.enabler_now: A signing step can send a subcontract the designer has already accepted, without adding an item.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong fabric or a wrong firm shows up in the finished room, and the designer chose it.
tasks.human_edge: The designer sets the subcontract and accepts it. The send is that version.
tasks.altitude: Choosing fabrication, installation, and the arrangement stays with the designer. The send is only the subcontract they accepted.

reach.task: Receive a subcontract the designer accepted
reach.learn: The items were chosen by the designer

evidence.claim: A subcontract whose items the designer has already chosen can be sent after they accept it. The send does not choose a firm or an item.

The designer judges safety, accessibility, and what the design should be. A tool does not certify compliance and does not generate the design. National rules decide which accessibility and safety duties apply. EU data-protection rules cover a client's home and their preferences. Client conferences are not stored as audio. A drawing or a specification is filed only after the designer made it. This work does not generate or edit an image.

assumptions: The workflow starts when fabrication or installation must be placed and ends when the accepted subcontract is sent. Choosing the items and the firm stays with the designer.
The fields are trade, item, the firm the designer named, and their acceptance. The designer produces the item and the firm. If a line is missing, they type it. The send is those lines and no others.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree on choosing the work. They disagree only about sending a subcontract the designer has already accepted.
Upkeep is keeping the trade names on the subcontract aligned with the job.
unknowns: Which firms the designer is allowed to subcontract.
Whether the client must countersign the subcontract.
research_questions: Which firms may the designer subcontract?
Must the client countersign the subcontract?

already_counted.description: Subcontracting fabrication of the furniture stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Keep the trade names on the subcontract aligned with the job

approvals.approved_version: subcontract the designer accepted after choosing fabrication, installation, and the arrangement

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the client must countersign, that signature stays, and the low end is choosing the work, which stays either way. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select, design, and purchase furnishings and accessories.

steps.what: Select furnishings and accessories.
Design the furnishings where needed.
Decide the purchase of those furnishings.
Accept the purchase of the furnishings.
Send the accepted furnishings purchase.

tasks.design: The designer selects or designs the furnishings and accessories, and decides the purchase. Only the purchase they accept is sent. Nothing selects an item or a price.
tasks.previous_blocker: The selection is the judgement. Sending the same lines is a second pass.
tasks.enabler_now: A purchasing step can send lines the designer has already selected and accepted.
tasks.still_hard: A furnishing the client did not want is the designer's to refuse before the order goes.
tasks.human_edge: The designer selects and accepts the purchase. The send is that version.
tasks.altitude: Selecting and designing furnishings stay with the designer. The send is only the purchase they accepted.

reach.task: Receive a purchase the designer accepted
reach.learn: The furnishings were selected by the designer

evidence.claim: A purchase whose lines the designer has selected can be sent after they accept it. The send does not select a furnishing.

The designer judges safety, accessibility, and what the design should be. A tool does not certify compliance and does not generate the design. National rules decide which accessibility and safety duties apply. EU data-protection rules cover a client's home and their preferences. Client conferences are not stored as audio. A drawing or a specification is filed only after the designer made it. This work does not generate or edit an image.

assumptions: The workflow starts when furnishings or accessories are to be bought and ends when the accepted purchase is sent. Selecting and designing them stays with the designer. Nothing suggests an item.
The fields are item, quantity the designer stated, and their acceptance. The designer produces the item. If a line is missing, they type it. The send is those lines and no others.
The prior treats the task as amplify. The steps disagree in part: selecting and designing stay, and only the send of an accepted purchase is shorter.
Upkeep is keeping the item names on the purchase aligned with the design.
unknowns: Whether prices are already fixed in a trade account.
Whether the client must approve the purchase before it is sent.
research_questions: Are prices already fixed in a trade account?
Must the client approve the purchase before it is sent?

already_counted.description: Selecting furnishings and accessories stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Keep the item names on the purchase aligned with the design

approvals.approved_version: furnishings purchase the designer accepted after selecting them

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the client must approve before the send, that approval stays, and the low end is the selection and the design, which stay either way. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Estimate materials and present the design for approval.

steps.what: Estimate material requirements for the design.
State the costs for those material requirements.
Present the design to the client for approval.
Accept the estimate after that approval.
File the accepted material estimate.

tasks.design: The designer estimates material requirements, states the costs, and presents the design to the client for approval. The file stores the estimate only after that presentation, and only the version the designer accepts. The presentation is not recorded. Nothing sets a price.
tasks.previous_blocker: The estimate and the presentation are the work. Filing the accepted figures is a second pass.
tasks.enabler_now: A file can hold material quantities and costs the designer has already stated and accepted after the client presentation.
tasks.still_hard: The client can refuse the design in the room, and only the designer hears that and changes the estimate.
tasks.human_edge: The designer estimates, presents, and accepts the version. The file stores that estimate.
tasks.altitude: Estimating and presenting the design stay with the designer. The file holds the estimate only after the presentation and their acceptance.

reach.task: Approve a design the designer presented
reach.learn: The presentation was in person with the designer

evidence.claim: Material quantities and costs the designer has stated can be stored after they accept the version they presented. The client presentation is not replaced and is not recorded.

The designer judges safety, accessibility, and what the design should be. A tool does not certify compliance and does not generate the design. National rules decide which accessibility and safety duties apply. EU data-protection rules cover a client's home and their preferences. Client conferences are not stored as audio. A drawing or a specification is filed only after the designer made it. This work does not generate or edit an image.

assumptions: The workflow starts when materials must be priced and ends when the accepted estimate is on the file. The presentation to the client stays a conversation and is not recorded. The file step is after that conversation.

The fields are material, quantity, cost the designer stated, and their acceptance after the presentation. The designer produces the figures. If a figure is missing, they type it. Nothing proposes a price.
The prior treats the task as amplify. The steps agree on the estimate and the presentation. They disagree only about filing figures the designer has already accepted.
Upkeep is keeping the material names aligned with the estimate file.
unknowns: Whether the client must sign the estimate as well as approve it in the meeting.
Which cost items the client treats as allowances.
research_questions: Must the client sign the estimate as well as approve it in the meeting?
Which cost items does the client treat as allowances?

already_counted.description: Estimating material requirements for the design stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Keep the material names aligned with the estimate file

approvals.approved_version: material estimate the designer accepted after presenting the design to the client

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the client meeting is long, the low end is the estimate and the presentation, which stay. Only the file copy of the accepted figures is shorter. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

Filing an estimate only after the client presentation
